media_src: D, Oct. 10, 2026 (Checkpoint 3b): the page rebuilt after the Brand Bible, the work straight on the paper. The signature written on, first, looping (Final Assets/Video/SB-Video-Logo-Script-16x9-White.mp4, 7.5 to 13 s: the book, then the script, before the film's closing credit; cropped, its white mapped to the paper, no sound); the book drawn by hand (03 Source/Sketches/Hand drawing/SB-Book-Drawing-Timelapse.mov, cut before its last clean frame and fade, cropped to the drawing, twice the speed, its white mapped to the site's paper and under the grain); the fourteen marks, numbered and labeled with the Bible's words and sizes (transparent PNGs from 01 Deliverables/Final Assets/Logos, copied at 1600 px); the six colors as plain swatches with the Bible's names and roles; in use, the tote, the cap and the tags, then the announcement film. Then (D, Oct. 10, more room and order after the Bible): the type, five faces and the hierarchy, as transparent specimens rendered once from the package's fonts with the Bible's own lines (never shipped as fonts); Journal & Press on its own; stationery and the shop, each piece cut on its own from the Bible's page source at its real relative size; the studies and the delivery sheets back. The client's name and email are censored (D, Oct. 10): on the business card and the email signature (re-cut with solid bars in place of the text) and on study page 30 (a copy, its first word under a bar).
